target_customer: Content marketers and short form video creators and teams making TikTok, Instagram and YouTube content
problem: Professional video editors such as Premiere Pro are hard to learn, run offline and make team collaboration painful. Ozone aimed to put editing, AI assistance and real time collaboration in the browser.
business_model: Freemium SaaS subscription for a browser based video editor
product_category: Collaborative cloud video editing with AI features

founders.name: Max von Wolff
education: MIT, computer science, left as a sophomore to join YC
founders.background_notes: Says he has been into filmmaking since age 15 (company page and TechCrunch interview).

competitors.name: Veed
competitors.funding_then: $35M from Sequoia, its first outside money, announced 2022-02

competitors.name: Descript
competitors.what: Text based audio and video editing with AI
competitors.funding_then: $50M round led by the OpenAI Startup Fund in 2022-11; earlier $30M round

technical_complexity.rationale: A browser native, GPU heavy timeline editor with real time multi user sync and cloud rendering is hard for a small team. The 2023 TechCrunch piece says the team spent nearly three years building before beta ended, per the YC page.

defensibility.rationale: Project files and cloud media storage create some lock in, but online editors such as Veed, Kapwing and Descript already existed and AI features were quickly copied across the category.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded editors added AI features through 2022 and 2023. The sources show no acquisition of Ozone.

market_need_then: Short form video demand from marketers and creators was high in 2022, and the founder argued Adobe tools were hard to use, offline and lacked collaboration. Figma style multiplayer tools had just proven that model in design.

branding.domain_note: Used ozone.pro, not a .com; the site returned 404 when checked in 2026.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product language: Figma for video, fastest way to edit videos with AI

branding.community_and_virality: A Product Hunt launch and a Vercel customer case study exist; no sign of merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a common word shared with many products, and searches mostly return other things. Press coverage was about the funding and the product, not the brand.

outcome_analysis: Ozone raised a $7.1M seed in November 2023 and launched out of beta, but YC lists it as Inactive. No source found states when or why it stopped, so the cause is not public and no failure factor is assigned. The category was crowded with funded editors such as Veed and Descript, and the browser editing wedge was easy for rivals to match with AI features.
notes: Shutdown date and cause not found in public sources despite two outcome searches; exit type left unknown. Welcome to the Jungle lists an earlier $0.2M seed in 2022-09 (single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round). Maginative says NEA led the round but TechCrunch names no lead. ozone.pro returned 404. Competitor entries are dated 2022 where the source is dated 2022; the Adobe entry is from the 2023 article. Removed undated or late competitors (Adobe Premiere Pro and Final Cut Pro) to keep the list contemporaneous.
